fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detect usage of the "coregen.exe" (Microsoft CoreCLR Native Image Generator) binary to sideload arbitrary DLLs.
fields.name: Potential DLL Sideloading Using Coregen.exe
fields.query: event.type="Module Load" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (src.process.image.path contains "\\coregen.exe" and (not (module.path contains "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft Silverlight\\" or module.path contains "C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Silverlight\\" or module.path contains "C:\\Windows\\System32\\" or module.path contains "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\"))))
